'''Jaen Kett''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] residing on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during its [[Separatist War|Civil War]]. He was stationed in a hot zone on the island of [[Mannett Point]], where he kept several war orphan kids, protecting them from the conflict. He enlisted the help of a [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|promising sergeant]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and a [[Voidhound|smuggler]] to help him get the children to a safer zone. They both agreed to help him, and the children were retrieved to a safer zone in Republic territory.<ref name="TOR" />
